2014_spells.sacred-flame.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.
2014_spells.sacred-flame.effectSummary: Deal 1d8 radiant damage to a target within 60 ft
2014_spells.sacred-flame.fullDescription: Using 1 action, flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw; roll a d20, add the DEX modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC or take 1d8 radiant damage; The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw; The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8). Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range.
